items.question: Which channels does OneInFlowAI support?
items.answer: OneInFlowAI currently supports Website live chat, LINE OA text messaging, and Facebook Page Messenger text messaging through one shared conversation workflow.

items.question: Do I need to write any code?
items.answer: No. Connect a channel, upload your knowledge, and the AI starts drafting replies. Developers can still use our API for deeper integrations.

items.question: How does the AI stay accurate?
items.answer: Every reply is grounded in your knowledge base using semantic search, and agents can review or override AI suggestions at any time.

items.question: Can I run multiple brands or properties?
items.answer: Yes. Each workspace is fully isolated, so you can manage many brands, teams, or properties from a single account.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Workspaces are isolated at the database level and access is scoped per user. Your conversations never train shared models.
